programme.desc: To kick off the series, Donal shares his love for a real family favourite - pasta! Using simple tips and flavour hacks, Donal shows us four new ways to prepare pasta.

programme.title: Donal's Real Time Recipes
programme.desc: Donal brings us four internationally inspired-bowls - a Citrus Pork Bowl; a Chicken Katsu Bowl; Tomato & Chickpea Orecchiette Soup; and a Middle Eastern Lamb Bowl.

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: It's summer week and the sewers make light and airy outfits, including a summer dress, a creation from old hammocks and a two-piece trouser co-ord for a man or a woman.

programme.title: Mary Berry Makes It Easy
programme.desc: Mary joins her friend Mel Giedroyc on a camping trip and shares some delicious recipes: a hearty chicken tartiflette, a speedy veg ragù and some creamy raspberry parfaits, all made easy.

programme.title: Nadiya's Family Favourites
programme.desc: Nadiya creates dishes ideal for family get-togethers, learns how to perfect her BBQ technique with BBQ-King James, and meets Paul Ainsworth, Michelin Star Chef.

programme.title: Junior Bake Off
programme.desc: Whose choux musicals scene gets a standing ovation on Pastry Day?

programme.title: Cook Clever, Waste Less With Prue & Rupy
programme.desc: David and Nadya are at their wits' end; their big food bills and their sons' allergies make mealtimes challenging and create a lot of waste. Can Prue and Rupy's time and money-saving food plan help?

programme.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall
programme.desc: Rick visits a mausoleum with a macabre story on the River Tamar, meets chef Emily Scott to taste the meal she cooked for Joe Biden, and takes to the waves with a organisation offering surfing therapy.

programme.title: Nisha Katona's Home Kitchen
programme.desc: Nisha Katona is cooking a spicy egg and cauliflower curry, a Himalayan chilli and cheese toastie with tamarind chutney and some sweet Hungarian plum dumplings.

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: Scraps are put to use in Reduce, Reuse, Recycle week to create quilted patchwork jackets. Old coats are given a new lease of life and second-hand duvets become maxi dresses.

programme.title: Grand Designs
programme.desc: To mark 25 years of the nation's favourite homebuilding programme, Kevin McCloud celebrates the triumphs and commiserates the disasters as he looks back at some iconic moments.

programme.title: Bake Off: The Professionals
programme.desc: The teams create 24 classic Battenberg cakes, 24 boldly re-invented ones, and a Shakespearean theatrical scene. Whose chance to progress is not to be?

programme.title: The Graham Norton Show
programme.desc: Graham Norton presents a lively chat show featuring Bruce Springsteen, Amy Adams, Vanessa Williams, Bill Bailey and St. Vincent.

programme.title: The World Today
programme.desc: The World Today is the core rolling service of CGTN. keep viewers up-to-date with all the world's top stories as they happen.

programme.title: The Agenda
programme.desc: A weekly talk-show looking beyond the headlines and “accepted wisdom” to find the real story. Hosted by award-winning journalist and presenter Stephen Cole, The Agenda quite simply sets The Agenda . You won’t find the same-old talking heads recycling platitudes; instead thought-provoking guests to debate and explore key issues of today’s world. Using virtual reality graphics to bring subjects to life, Stephen will navigate through subjects ranging from “Prove That Climate Change Exists” to “Who Will Win the Race to Space”. Opposing views will be given opportunity to flourish and develop into a meaningful conversation. The Agenda: No nonsense talk; Challenging perceptions.

programme.title: Africa Live
programme.desc: Africa Live is a news program that focuses on African issues and issues related to this diverse continent. CGTN's Nairobi-based broadcast center produces Africa Live.

programme.title: Talk Africa
programme.desc: Talk Africa is a weekly discussion show that brings the most influential voices in Africa to the world.

programme.title: Sports Scene
programme.desc: Sports Scene brings you closer to all the action from all corners of the world, with highlights from across Europe, North America and China's top sports leagues.

programme.title: Biz Talk
programme.desc: A groundbreaking 30-minute interview show, giving an in-depth look into how top companies around the world conduct business and how policymakers view the fast-changing world economy. It presents 360 degree profiles of industry movers and shakers, tech mavericks and policymakers, and drills down on the stories behind their success, to give you clarity on what’s happening in every facet of business.

programme.title: The World Today
programme.desc: The World Today is the core rolling service of CGTN. keep viewers up-to-date with all the world's top stories as they happen.

programme.title: Travelogue

programme.title: The World Today
programme.desc: The World Today is the core rolling service of CGTN. keep viewers up-to-date with all the world's top stories as they happen.

programme.title: The Agenda
programme.desc: A weekly talk-show looking beyond the headlines and “accepted wisdom” to find the real story. Hosted by award-winning journalist and presenter Stephen Cole, The Agenda quite simply sets The Agenda . You won’t find the same-old talking heads recycling platitudes; instead thought-provoking guests to debate and explore key issues of today’s world. Using virtual reality graphics to bring subjects to life, Stephen will navigate through subjects ranging from “Prove That Climate Change Exists” to “Who Will Win the Race to Space”. Opposing views will be given opportunity to flourish and develop into a meaningful conversation. The Agenda: No nonsense talk; Challenging perceptions.

programme.title: Africa Live
programme.desc: Africa Live is a news program that focuses on African issues and issues related to this diverse continent. CGTN's Nairobi-based broadcast center produces Africa Live.

programme.title: Talk Africa
programme.desc: Talk Africa is a weekly discussion show that brings the most influential voices in Africa to the world.

programme.title: Biz Talk
